## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 2 (*Akālacīvara*, "Distributing out-of-season robe-cloth") is the second rule in the chapter on offenses entailing relinquishment and confession (*nissaggiya pācittiya*) in the nun's analysis of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. The disciplinary rule establishes that a nun who distributes robe-cloth inappropriately must relinquish the robe-cloth and confess the offense. An English translation of the text is provided by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

 Within the Pali tradition, it corresponds directly to Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha Nissaggiya Pācittiya 2 (*pli-tv-bi-pm-np2*) and is treated in the Bhikkhunī Parivāra. Cross-tradition parallels include Prātimokṣa and Vibhaṅga versions in Dharmaguptaka (*Lzh Dg Bi Vb Np 27*), Sarvāstivāda (*Lzh Sarv Bi Vb Np20* and *Np21*), Mahīśāsaka (*Lzh Mi Bi Vb Np20*), and Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya recensions preserved in Chinese (*Lzh Mu Bi Vb Np 22*, *Np 23*) and Classical Tibetan (*xct-mu-bi-vb-np22*, *np23*).
